extension.summary: A record shelf for your Kodi music library.
extension.description: Native Kodi 21 album browsing with a quiet perspective shelf. Artist, year and title ordering; open at the playing album or a random starting position, then play a complete album in disc/track order. No Format server, account, catalogue or downloader. Uses the music already indexed by Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: 1.0 release candidate. Pi hardware acceptance is required before everyday use. Selecting Play album replaces the current Kodi music queue and disables shuffle for ordered album playback.
